# Cheaper Alternatives to Blackbaud

Here are several cost-effective alternatives to Blackbaud's nonprofit software:

## **All-in-One Solutions**

**1. Bloomerang** ($125-$500/month)
- Donor management & CRM
- Email marketing included
- Better pricing for small-mid sized nonprofits
- Strong customer support

**2. DonorPerfect** ($89-$269/month)
- Comprehensive donor database
- Integrated fundraising tools
- More affordable than Raiser's Edge

**3. Kindful** (Starting ~$100/month)
- Modern interface
- Good reporting features
- Integrates with blogging platforms

## **Budget-Friendly Options**

**4. Little Green Light** ($59-$149/month)
- Full-featured donor management
- Excellent for small nonprofits
- Transparent pricing

**5. Neon CRM** ($50-$200/month)
- Membership management
- Event registration
- Donation processing

## **Free/Low-Cost Options**

**6. CiviCRM** (Free, open-source)
- Completely free
- Requires technical setup
- Very customizable

**7. Bitrix24** (Free tier available)
- CRM with nonprofit features
- Collaboration tools included

## **What are you primarily using Blackbaud for?**
(Donor management, events, accounting, peer-to-peer fundraising?) This will help me recommend the best specific alternative for your needs.
